task: Prove that an ABI-v10 source-free generic empty-vector consumer uses its checked-body record.
observation: A narrowly gated compiler trace at checked-body projection made the imported execution path observable. With the provider source tree removed, the R2c consumer compiled and ran both Vector[i32] and Vector[bool] cases, while a separate focused artifact mutation suite rejected missing and inconsistent summary/body records and unsupported body forms.
impact: The branch trace plus fail-closed mutations distinguish checked-body consumption from successful execution through retained generic_stmt fallback.

resolution.summary: The consumer now decodes only canonical empty-vector checked bodies, replaces the imported legacy projection, and proves the selected branch in acceptance tests.
